<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );

// Redirection keeps its rules in its own tables; create them, then a group.
// Redirection installs its tables on first use of its admin; install them now.
foreach ( array( 'Redirection\\Database\\Database', 'Database' ) as $db ) {
	if ( class_exists( $db ) && method_exists( $db, 'get_latest_database' ) ) {
		$db::get_latest_database()->install();
		break;
	}
}
$group = class_exists( 'Red_Group' ) ? Red_Group::create( 'Demo', 1 ) : null;

// A chain, a loop and a self-redirect in Redirection.
foreach ( array( array( '/old-about', '/about-old' ), array( '/about-old', '/about-2020' ), array( '/about-2020', '/sample-page' ), array( '/loop-a', '/loop-b' ), array( '/loop-b', '/loop-a' ), array( '/self', '/self' ) ) as $rule ) {
	if ( $group ) {
		Red_Item::create( array( 'url' => $rule[0], 'action_data' => array( 'url' => $rule[1] ), 'group_id' => $group->get_id(), 'match_type' => 'url', 'action_type' => 'url', 'action_code' => 301 ) );
	}
}

// A loop across plugins and a duplicate, in Simple 301 Redirects.
update_option( '301_redirects', array( '/loop-c' => '/loop-a', '/self' => '/self', '/old-promo' => '/sample-page' ) );

// A first scan, so the dashboard has something to show.
if ( class_exists( '\\Acato\\RedirectInspector\\Includes\\Scanner' ) ) {
	\Acato\RedirectInspector\Includes\Scanner::run( 'manual' );
}
